EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
I hope you are doing well and you had a great weekend.
If you want to add a property to your Memphis Invest portfolio but do not have the funds necessary to fund your next deal, this email is meant specifically for you.
I wanted to let you know that there is a possibility for you to add at least 1 property to your portfolio with Memphis Invest with little or no money out of pocket using your self-directed IRA or your solo-401k.
Since you previously purchased at least one property through Memphis Invest using your IRA/solo-k outright without financing, I want to show you how you can borrow against the equity in the property you already own to purchase a 2nd property with very little (or possibly, nothing) out of pocket.
Bridge Capital is now offering non-recourse financing on 20 year, fixed rate at 8.4% with 50% down terms, which are far and away the best non-recourse terms we have ever been able to obtain through our financing partners.
Many of you receiving this email will immediately see how favorable those terms really are, as you might have loans outstanding between 10-12% through our past non-recourse financing options.
Please take a look at the attachment to this email. I've put together a very simple powerpoint that explains the process of cross collateralization and I provided a real example of how I just finished helping one of my clients acquire their 2nd property with almost nothing out of pocket.
If this is something that you are interested in talking about, please schedule a call with me this week and we can discuss your options.
Please let me know how I can help you build your portfolio!
Sincerely,
Marq
